findings.source_quote: See the editorial under the section “continued changes” for further details.

findings.translation_quote: for å utløse immunresponsen. Skape immunitet.

findings.suggested_fix: Translate the needle-size unit rather than retaining the English gauge term; for example, «(21 gauge eller mindre)» may be retained with a brief Norwegian clarification such as «(21 gauge eller mindre, altså en svært tynn nål)».
